row.body: The two items are bundled beside marked feed sack; field dust lies beneath them, while a strip of road tape is caught around the bundle.
row.title: Marked feed sack by the kitchen chair

sidecar.gloss: Field residue and response material share one personal bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: Field work and a hurried emergency response could each explain the mixed residue and road tape; neither fixes which came first.
